propositions: A compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext via uvicorn access logs before code fix 66af was deployed to production.

The fix (66af) moves token sourcing from query string (`?token=`) to HTTP header (`X-Rebar-Token`) and adds TokenRedactingFilter to redaction, but must be deployed before rotation to prevent re-leaking the new token.

The GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret used simultaneously for outbound Gerrit HTTP basic-auth, inbound webhook validation, and container environment configuration, requiring coordinated rotation via service-user.sh to keep all three in sync.
Production container image (built 2026-08-04T11:07Z) predates 66af merge and still reads token from URL and lacks redaction filter, confirming deployment prerequisite is not yet met.

Token rotation requires: deploy 66af to prod, run service-user.sh to update Gerrit password/SSM/webhooks.config, restart bot container, and verify end-to-end inbound webhook and outbound vote with new credential.
